lede: The biggest item this week is Monday's Town Council meeting, where three substantive things are on the table: a Fourth Supplement to the Gondola IGA that advances cost-sharing on the gondola replacement project, plus first readings of two ordinances — one touching the Telluride Energy Mitigation Program and another not yet fully described. Meanwhile, Ouray County commissioners are deep in it, weighing a fifth extension of their Emergency Disaster Declaration and a preliminary draft agreement to merge EMS with Ridgway Fire — a structural decision with long-term consequences for emergency response across the valley. On the lighter side, Halloween week is fully loaded with the Witches Ride, the TMHS Young Frankenstein musical, and the downtown parade Friday.

notable.stake: First readings on two ordinances; gondola IGA cost-sharing vote moves forward.
Fifth Emergency Disaster Declaration extension; vacancy hires under austerity resolution.
Preliminary EMS-Ridgway Fire merger agreement shapes emergency response for years.
P&Z votes on lot-line vacation and merger at 510 W Columbia in historic West Telluride.
